groups.why_chosen: A triangular masked-attention block map, coloured data-vs-compute, whose colours carry into flat per-device shelves for two placements so the reader can just count blue tiles to see the imbalance vanish.
groups.what_to_learn: Draw the triangular block map once, colour data vs compute blocks, then reuse those colours in flat per-device shelves so imbalance is countable at a glance — but no arrows mark which block moved between placements.
